**UI v2 is now live in the Omni mainnet! ✨**

This is one of our largest releases yet, and was designed to address much of the user feedback we’ve received.

 **UI v2 & New Features**
We’ve heard three recurring points of feedback on the UI from the beginning: denser, darker, sharper. So, we did a complete overhaul of our UI to add:
* Denser tables and smaller text
* Darker backgrounds & more contrast
* Sharper lines & less rounded corners

* Draggable chart sizing
* Est. liquidation price on the order entry form
* Brand-new PnL card designs
* & more… see the [v0.1.66 release notes](LINK) for the full list.

**Rewards Page**
The initial implementation of the Omni rewards page is officially live. You can now progress between tiers (which are based on 30d rolling volume) and see how much you’ve saved in fees by trading on Omni.

Note that the majority of rewards functionality (loss refunds, spread discounts, referral rewards claiming) is not yet live. We expect to roll these out one-by-one going forward. 

**Referral Freeze** 
We also chose to implement a freeze on new referral codes with this release. The simple reasoning is that we want to continue to limit the number of users on the Private Beta as we are still yet-to-implement a number of key features (including loss refunds, spread discounts, OLP deposits, etc).

All already-earned referral code uses are still valid. We expect to re-enable the ability to earn more referral code uses within a few weeks. 

**What’s Next?**
Obviously, there’s still plenty of work to be done! Some of our near-term roadmap items include:

* Adding rewards functionality (loss refunds, spread discounts, platform credit, etc).
* Enabling referral rewards claims.
* Improved portfolio page analytics
* OLP statistics page
* & more… check out the [full roadmap in the docs](<https://docs.variational.io/roadmap>). 

As always, we’d like to say *thank you* to the entire Variational community for continuing to support us and provide us with invaluable feedback along this journey.

New announcement from 0xmgb in Discord:

**Loss refunds are now live on the Omni mainnet!**

Starting right now, every time you close a losing trade on Omni, you have between a 1 and 5% chance to get that loss completely refunded. The full mechanism is explained in the [docs](<https://docs.variational.io/omni/rewards/loss-refunds>). 

Loss refunds are funded by a portion of the spread revenue that the Omni Liquidity Provider (OLP) earns as the sole counterparty to trades. This design ensures that loss refunds are sustainable long-term, even with zero fees. 

Currently, 1/6th of spread revenue is redirected to the Loss Refund Pool (which you can track on-chain [here](<https://arbiscan.io/address/0xc47756133753280c37b227c24782984e021c4544>)).  

Loss refunds are available on all markets, for all users, starting right now.

Happy trading @here!

In the coming months, we will focus on four things:
• Further raising OI limits on swap markets
• Regularly listing many more swap and perp markets
• Launching a trading API
• Enabling 24/7 liquidity for swaps
